test_title: PYST 11: Selection Post (GraduatiOn Level) - English (Held On 21 Jun, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: english
question: What is the message one gets from this story?

options.text: If you work hard and follow your dream, you will get success.
It is okay not to follow your dreams.
Follow you passion but don’t work hard.

solution:
The correct answer is Option 1)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sheena's Determination: **The passage highlights **Sheena's strong determination** to become a doctor despite financial difficulties, showcasing her commitment to her dreams. 
 
• **Hard Work:** Sheena’s decision to work at a restaurant **till midnight demonstrates her willingness to put in hard work to achieve her goals.**
 
• **Father’s Sacrifice:** The story also includes** the father's significant sacrifice by selling his ancestral property, underscoring the importance of support and hard work in pursuing dreams.**
 
• **Academic Achievement:** Sheena’s success in securing a **3rd all India ranking** in the joint medical entrance test further emphasizes that hard work and dedication lead to success.
 
• **Inspiring Outcome: **The ultimate outcome, where **Sheena gets admission into a government medical college, **serves as an inspiration that perseverance pays off.
 
• **Overall Message:** The overarching message of the passage is clear—**persistent efforts and following one’s dreams, despite challenges, can lead to success.**

Therefore, the correct answer is **'Option 1'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2:** It is okay not to follow your dreams - Incorrect, as the story reflects the benefits of following one's dreams.
 
• **Option 3:** Follow your passion but don’t work hard - Incorrect, since Sheena’s success is directly attributed to her hard work.
 
• **Option 4: **One should not work hard - Incorrect, because the whole narrative revolves around the importance of working hard to achieve success.
